items.rule: Always retract closing callout pills and return dynamic hero state toward frame zero before the final loop whip so the last frame settles cleanly onto the opening frame.
items.proposed_gate: Compute SSIM between the final settled loop frame and frame 0 and fail if similarity drops below 0.92 or if closing callout elements remain opaque within the last 10 frames.

items.rule: Label each force or physical-quantity vector with its unit or concept, style static gravitational or applied forces differently from motion arrows, and never draw an arrow against a body's travel direction unless it is labeled as an opposing force.
items.proposed_gate: Assert that any directional arrow icon within a translating component container matches the sign of the container velocity vector unless an explicit vector label prop is present.

items.rule: Render captions and persistent chrome on a dedicated top-level track at full opacity, isolated from camera zooms, overlays, and transitions so nothing moves or dims them.
items.proposed_gate: Verify that all persistent UI elements and headers maintain minimum padding within the safe boundary (y >= 100) across all rendered frames.

items.rule: Break caption text at natural clause boundaries, never strand an article, preposition, or lone short word on a line, and cap burned-in captions at two lines kept clear of the stage hero and navigation deck.
items.proposed_gate: Lint generated caption chunks before render and reject blocks ending a line with a dangling function word or starting a new sentence with one trailing word.

items.proposed_gate: Compute frame-to-frame stage-region structural diff and camera transform variance over sliding 2.0 s windows and fail if motion stays below threshold or camera transform remains constant across consecutive beats.
